vb_textbox.text: First, I thought that the selection of gnomes is random and does not provide regularity of getting larger number of mushrooms. However, once you select a gnome who can bring you to collect a lot of mushrooms, like over 6 mushrooms, try to think about the design of gnome. Based on this, you can guess whether the same gnome apperes on the next round or not. If so, the same gnome likely bring you to the forest where you can collect many mushrooms. If there are two completely different gnomes there, there are two patterns you can select either 1) choose a similar figure of gnome to the gnome that took you to a forest where you could gather many mushrooms last time, or 2) choose different figure one (e.g. if you selected tall hat one last time, choose small hat one). However, this is completely luck whether you can pick a gnome who will bring you to a forest where you can gather many mushrooms!
